name: zotero-mcp
description: Search, read, synthesize, and safely organize a local Zotero library through zotero-mcp with optional Ollama semantic search.

interface.shortDescription: Research and organize a local Zotero library.
interface.longDescription: Search Zotero metadata and full text, read PDFs and annotations, synthesize literature, export bibliographies, manage library records with confirmation, and build a private semantic index using local Ollama bge-m3 embeddings.
defaultPrompt: Find and synthesize the most relevant papers in my Zotero library.
Read this Zotero paper and summarize its methods and findings.
Check my local Zotero semantic index and update it if needed.
